# Migration fixtures

- `aspnet-password.json`: public development seed already present in `database/02_seed_du_lieu.sql`; its format is ASP.NET Core Identity V3. It is never copied into user data automatically.
- `smtp-cert.pem` / `smtp-key.pem`: **public test-only key pair**, generated for localhost/127.0.0.1/::1, valid for ten years from October 2026. Used only by local SMTP tests to verify STARTTLS and implicit TLS with certificate verification enabled. Never deploy this key or use it as an application/SMTP credential.
- Additional V2/V3 PRF vectors are assembled in the JavaScript test from the documented binary format; they are not claimed to have been generated by a running C# tool.

Format source: [Microsoft PasswordHasher implementation](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/Identity/Extensions.Core/src/PasswordHasher.cs). Transport APIs: [Nodemailer SMTP](https://nodemailer.com/smtp), [SMTP Server](https://nodemailer.com/extras/smtp-server).
